about_the_game:
Save up to 75% and get maximum benefits with our exclusive seasonal Battle Pack for STALCRAFT!

Battle Pack Includes:

  • 20 cases with unique 3D styles specially created for the summer event "Crow Arena". Enjoy rare paints and legendary skins that will highlight your style!
  • Instantly boost your Battle Pass level by 20. Stay ahead of everyone else and gain access to exclusive rewards and bonuses to fully experience your superiority and become the Arena Champion.
  • 20 Gladiatorial Loot Cases available only within the summer battle pass. Each of them may contain unique paints and useful resources, as well as blueprints for the rarest weapons such as McMilan CS5 and MG42!

Note!

  • This seasonal Battle Pack can only be purchased once per character.
  • The Battle Pack reward could be found on your "Personal Warehouse."
  • This Battle Pack is not cross-platform and can only be used on Steam.
  • The Battle Pack can only be granted to the same Steam account that was used to made the purchase. If you have some issues, contact our EXBO Support.
  • EXBO may update, replace, or remove in-game content at any time.
  • If you activate a Battle Pack purchased in Steam on a character on which it has already been purchased in the in-game shop, you will be credited its value in stalcoins instead of receiving the contents of the Battle Pack again.
